title: NerfTracker: is your AI model nerfed?
excerpt: Every day NerfTracker gives each coding agent the same jobs on a fresh machine, then records what it builds.
content_html:
Every model gets the same written brief and one attempt, working in its own coding tool (Claude Code, Codex or Grok Build) at high effort, with no human help. Each run starts on a clean macOS user account that has only what a brand-new Mac has, locked inside a sandbox. Nothing carries over between runs: memories, sessions, caches and leftover processes are wiped, and the clean state is verified by checksum before and after. Web search is allowed, and there’s a time limit per task.

Every session is recorded. The finished apps are then scored by hidden automated checks the models never see. Before any model runs, those checks must pass a reference solution and fail deliberately broken ones. Every app is also filmed doing the same scripted demo, so you can judge the results side by side.

The kart racer idea came from @matthewmillerai.
